notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); gate.digest is the digest line the last run printed, and check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. The card's five entry symbols all exist at commit 3e878e3f765a4295b0089d04e241d4beb7b8a65b. This package drives the first one, lantz.drivers.labjack._internal.u12:U12 (u12.py:395); Neo is an Andor camera wrapper that needs the vendor Andor SDK, DictFeat is a framework property class, and LoggingTCPServer/LoggingUDPServer are test logging utilities, not the device of this package. The upstream clone was never imported or run by this session, and native.py imports the upstream Lantz package only inside its hardware factory, which was never opened. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the helper hint PythonObjectDriver is not used; this is a direct Driver (the card's decision is direct-driver) because the U12 contract is a set of named native methods with a native reset stop, a catalogue read class, and x-cap actions with explicit limits. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD'S CANDIDATE CLASSES: cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor/sensor.imu/sensor.force_torque and cap.actuation.gpio.v1 binds io.gpio/io.digital (catalog show); this device is declared instrument.dmm and its voltage reading binds cap.measure.voltage.v1, whose resource kinds include instrument.dmm. cap.device.configure.v1 binds the local ID write. The card's reads hint getWinVersion is Windows-only and is not exposed. NOT COVERED: continuous streaming (aiStreamStart/aiStreamRead/aiStreamClear), digital I/O, getWinVersion, the watchdog and the low-level raw commands are not exposed; aiBurst block acquisition, pulseOutStart, eAnalogOut, eAnalogIn, eCount, localID/rawReadLocalId and reset are. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording of a device; its numbers are marked placeholders and are not Facts or Limits. It returns the requested number of aiBurst samples, while the real U12 aiBurst arrays have room for 4096 scans per channel. The analog output action echoes the applied voltages because U12.eAnalogOut has no readback (u12.py:1942-1969); the local ID write reads back through rawReadLocalId. site-limits.example.json is an example operator overlay, not a statement about any unit: it supplies the operator_required local ID, analog output and pulse ranges, while the aiBurst scan count and scan rate are capped by the upstream docstring (u12.py:2159). The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, no human reviewed or tested it, and no hardware run is claimed. The loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-written package only at R2 and R3; this package is R1, so that protection is not claimed, and the hardware backend must not be used before a human review.
